name: Hide address fields for parcel machines LITE
author: lunarweb98

sections.description:
When a customer selects a Montonio parcel machine or post office method at checkout, the plugin hides billing address fields (address line 1, address line 2, city, postcode) and conditionally manages the State field based on customer location.

LITE version features
– Choose one parcel machine service to enable
– Automatically hides address fields when the parcel machine method is selected
– Smart “State” handling (hidden for EU, visible for US where applicable)
– Simple, no-bloat admin screen

PRO (sold separately)
– Unlock support for all Montonio parcel-machine services
– Optional enhancements and priority support

Key Features

  • Auto-hides address fields for selected parcel-machine methods
  • Locale-aware State handling (e.g., hidden for EE, shown for US)
  • Simple dropdown selection (no coding)
  • HPOS compatible
  • Lightweight and fast

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0+
  • WooCommerce 7.0+ (WC tested up to: 10.1.2)
  • PHP 7.4+
  • Montonio Shipping plugin

Compatibility

  • Checkout: Classic Checkout only
  • Shipping: Works only with Montonio plugin parcel/post-office methods (Omniva, DPD, Venipak, Itella/Smartpost, Unisend, Latvian Post)
  • HPOS: Compatible (declares compatibility; does not access order data)

Troubleshooting

Fields not hiding?
– Confirm the chosen shipping method matches your selected provider
– Check that the Montonio plugin is active and configured
– Test with the Storefront theme to rule out theme overrides

State field behavior
– US customers will see the State field (outside parcel-machine flows)
– EU locales generally hide State automatically (and it is hidden during parcel-machine flows)

General tips
– Temporarily deactivate other checkout customizers to test conflicts
– Ensure you’re using Classic Checkout (not block-based)

Support

Email: harri@leiakink.ee

For information about the separate PRO edition, see the settings page link.

Documentation

See docs/USER_GUIDE.md included in this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload the ZIP file and activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → Parcel Machines (LITE).
  4. Choose your preferred parcel-machine service from the dropdown.
  5. Save changes.

The plugin will now automatically hide address fields when customers select your chosen parcel-machine method.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release — Classic Checkout only
  • Feature — Hide address fields (address 1, address 2, city, postcode) on Montonio parcel-machine selection
  • Feature — Locale-aware State handling (shown for US where applicable; hidden for EE and similar locales)
  • Compatibility — Declares WooCommerce HPOS support
  • Dev — WooCommerce-active guard, text domain & i18n loader; no public links or tracking
